# CS229: Machine Learning

> Stanford's flagship machine learning course covering supervised learning, unsupervised learning, reinforcement learning, and neural networks with comprehensive lecture notes, problem sets, and syllabi.

CS229 is one of Stanford's most popular computer science courses, taught by leading faculty members including Andrew Ng, Stefano Socci, and others. The course provides foundational and advanced training in machine learning theory and practice, with materials spanning multiple years and instructional formats.

## Key Topics

- Machine Learning
- Supervised Learning
- Unsupervised Learning
- Reinforcement Learning
- Neural Networks
- Support Vector Machines
- Kernel Methods
- Dimensionality Reduction
- Statistical Pattern Recognition
- Problem Sets
- Lecture Notes
- Python
- NumPy
- Course Syllabus
